title: Shocking Catchy Title #Shorts
topic: Dark Psychology: Manipulation tactics people secretly use in conversations
script: You think you know the way to get someone to do what you want? Think again. The most insidious manipulation tactic people use in conversations is not what you think. It's not 'empathy' or 'flattery'. It's actually... mirroring. They mimic your body language, your tone, your words. It's a clever way to build trust, to make you feel like you're in control. But what if I told you that's exactly what they're doing to control you? Are you being manipulated right now, without even realizing it? Can you spot the mirroring in your conversation with someone?
